name: dsh-whale-widget
description: A DeepSeek balance whale widget for the bottom-right corner of the DSH Web interface: balance/today's usage/peak and off-peak pricing, customizable bubble click sequences (text/balance/today/peak periods/images/random phrases and weighted parallel selection), per-line styling and fonts, hover quick editing, sound effects and per-turn cost notifications, custom characters/animations/sounds, and customizable snapping and mirroring.
